name: Mine4Ease
blurb: Mine4Ease is a multi-instance Minecraft launcher designed to provide an easy way to manage assets and instances for your game.
description:
Mine4Ease is a multi-instance Minecraft launcher designed to provide an
easy way to manage assets and instances for your game.

Features:

• Create and manage multiple Minecraft instances independently

• Support for Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Quilt mod loaders

• Browse and install modpacks from CurseForge and Feed The Beast (FTB)

• Search for and manage mods for your instances

• Simple login process and streamlined asset management

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
